scene: A pneumatic tube drops glowing envelopes onto the rumbling mail train floor.
beats: You unfold the glowing note, chuckling at its neon warning about runaway umbrellas. With a metallic screech, the mail train glides into Lost Property Depot and the doors slide open.
You flick errant letters into the pigeon's copper hopper, earning a shiny brass receipt token. Brakes hiss, and the doors part before the depot's towering shelves.
A quick twist releases a puff of violet steam, sending the train coasting smoothly to the bumpers. The depot doors open wide to reveal mountains of forgotten hats.
picture: Side-scrolling interior of a rattling train carriage. On the far left, a purple envelope sits on the floor beneath a pneumatic glass chute. Centre-left, the player stands in an orange jacket. In the centre, a mechanical pigeon perches beside a canvas sorter bag. On the far right, a hissing brass pipe valve glows overhead.
shown: a luminous purple envelope sitting sealed on the floor at the far left
a mechanical pigeon perched beside an open canvas sorter bag in the centre
a hissing overhead brass pipe valve glowing hot on the far right

after.label: Step off at Lost Property Depot
Stay on
after.beat: You stay aboard as the depot fades behind you. The train rattles to the line's end, where you board the night funicular, climbing steadily toward the cocoa-scented glow of Comet Watch Rooftop.
after.then: Step off at Comet Watch Rooftop
